title: Multi-Turn Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.01077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic caching lowers the cost of serving large language models (LLMs) by reusing stored responses for similar requests. In multi-turn conversations, whether a cached response is acceptable depends on both conversations' histories, which embedding similarity of requests and histories predicts poorly (AUC 0.62--0.74 on five workloads). We therefore learn the \emph{reuse risk}, the probability that a cached response is unacceptable, from judge feedback, and choose a budgeted set of conversation states to cache by weighing the generation cost a reuse avoids against a price for unacceptable reuse. We propose CUCB-SC-MT, which learns a cache from logged conversations with a suboptimality guarantee, and CLCB-LS-MT, which learns online and has $\tilde O(\sqrt N)$ regret over $N$ requests when conversation states recur. On math-tutoring (SocraTeach) and movie-ticketing (Taskmaster-3) conversations, both achieve lower loss than prior semantic

translated_title: 面向低成本大语言模型服务的多轮语义缓存
translated_abstract: 语义缓存通过为相似请求复用已存储的响应，降低了大语言模型（LLM）服务的成本。在多轮对话中，一个缓存的响应是否可接受取决于对话双方的历史，而请求与历史的嵌入相似度对此的预测效果较差（在五个工作负载上AUC仅为0.62–0.74）。因此，我们从评判者反馈中学习“复用风险”（即缓存响应不可接受的概率），并通过权衡复用所避免的生成成本与不可接受复用所付出的代价，在预算约束下选择一组对话状态进行缓存。我们提出了CUCB-SC-MT，它从记录的对话中学习缓存并具有次优性保证；以及CLCB-LS-MT，它进行在线学习，当对话状态重复出现时，在N个请求上具有Õ(√N)遗憾界。在数学辅导（SocraTeach）和电影订票（Taskmaster-3）对话数据上，两种方法均比先前的语义缓存方法取得了更低的损失。
tldr: 该论文提出面向多轮对话的语义缓存方法，通过从评判者反馈中学习“复用风险”来决定缓存哪些对话状态，并给出具有次优性保证和遗憾界的算法（CUCB-SC-MT与CLCB-LS-MT），在保证复用质量的同时降低LLM服务成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes multi-turn semantic caching for LLM serving by learning "reuse risk" from judge feedback, with algorithms CUCB-SC-MT and CLCB-LS-MT that offer suboptimality and regret guarantees while reducing serving costs.
